Spot.doc: A named spot on the map; features find their place by name.

Feature.doc: Sizes of a spot's ground feature: radius, height, depth (m). A rectangle uses the marker's own size.

Path.doc: Paths from this marker to the markers it names.

District.doc: A district: the marker's box (its size, x by z). Lower order wins where boxes overlap; kind 'bounds' is the map's edge.

Plot.doc: A house plot: the marker's size is the footprint (x by z) and its yaw the door side; upper: must have an upper floor.

Hangout.doc: Where villagers hang out (marker kind 'trip': a far destination reached over the navmesh).

Clear.doc: Keep trees, bushes and rocks this far from here.

Block.doc: A static collider filling the marker's box (round: an upright cylinder, its size x the diameter), its y above the ground; on: stand on that entity's ground instead of its own (a crane on a slope).

Entrance.doc: A way into the underground: kind manhole, cellar_door or trapdoor; you come up facing the marker's yaw.
